'''Juggernaut Five''' was an [[HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport]] used to move [[rhydonium]] on the [[planet]] [[Morak]], which was commandeered by [[Din Djarin]] and [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 15" /> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> The transport was attacked by [[Pirate|raiders]] attempting to destroy its valuable [[rhydonium]] cargo to the planet's [[Morak Imperial refinery|Imperial refinery]], but was successfully defended by Djarin. It was subsequently destroyed when Mayfeld fired on its Rhydonium shipment, causing a chain reaction that annihilated the refinery it was operating out of.<ref name="Chapter 15" />
